name: dcoe-roster
description: DCOE shared core (CORE.md, v1.8) for Claude Code, matching CLAUDE.md v3.6. Agent bodies live at ~/.claude/agents/ (user level) and are deployed automatically by a SessionStart hook running agent-bodies-reference/bootstrap.mjs on Operations/Pappa T, and by a repo-level hook (hub-template/hooks/cloud-roster-bootstrap.sh) on Claude Code cloud/web sessions where the plugin-based hook never fires. This plugin still ships no agent definitions of its own, so the loader never double-lists them.
